sr.q: What types of cargo does Barq handle?
sr.a: We handle all types including general cargo, temperature-controlled freight, hazardous materials (with proper documentation), oversized project cargo, and high-value goods. Our multi-modal network covers road, air, and sea.
Yes. Our end-to-end logistics solutions include pickup from the origin, all transit handling, customs clearance, and final-mile delivery to the destination address — domestically and internationally.

sr.q: How do I track my shipment?
sr.a: Contact the Barq Cargo support team with your shipment reference for status updates and delivery information.

sr.q: What is your expertise in temperature-controlled logistics?
sr.a: Barq operates a dedicated reefer fleet capable of maintaining temperatures from -25°C to +25°C. We specialize in perishables including fresh produce, pharmaceuticals, and dairy products across domestic and export corridors.

Our licensed customs brokers handle all documentation, duty calculations, HS code classification, and regulatory compliance on your behalf. We work across all major ports including Karachi, Lahore Dry Port, and Islamabad airport.

sr.q: Can Barq handle large project cargo?
sr.a: Absolutely. Our project handling division specializes in heavy-lift, oversized, and multi-piece cargo requiring specialized equipment, route surveys, and government NOCs. Contact us for a detailed project assessment.
